ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAB.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBABenchMarkCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAB.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>ABBA - Run Benchmark
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAB.description: Runs a complete ABBA workflow on a demo dataset (mouse atlas, import, two DeepSlice runs, Elastix affine and spline registrations, QuPath export for the remote datasets) and reports the time and memory used by each step.

input.name: comment
input.label: Comment
input.description: Free text copied in the report, for instance to describe the machine.

input.name: demo_dataset
input.label: Demo dataset
input.description: Remote datasets are streamed from a public OMERO server (needs the OMERO dependencies). Local datasets are downloaded once from Zenodo and cached (about 1 GB per slide).

input.name: use_gui
input.label: Use graphical user interface
input.description: If checked, the benchmark runs in an ABBA window; otherwise it runs without display.

input.name: wait_between_each_step
input.label: Time each registration step
input.description: If checked, each registration step waits for all sections to be done before the next one starts, so that each step is timed separately. Slower.

output.name: report
output.label: Report
output.description: Markdown report: configuration, time and memory per step. Also written to the ImageJ log.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAC.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBACheckForUpdateCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAC.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Help>ABBA - Check for updates
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAC.description: Compares the installed ABBA version with the latest release on GitHub and shows the result in a dialog.
messages: Needs an internet connection. The result is shown in a dialog window.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAC.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBACiteInfoCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAC.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Cite>ABBA - How to cite
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAC.description: Shows how to cite ABBA and the tools it uses, in a window (requires an internet connection).
messages: Needs an internet connection. The citation information is shown in a window.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAC.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBACloseCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAC.description: Closes an ABBA session and releases it. Unsaved work is lost.
messages: The session cannot be used after this command. Save the state before closing to keep the work.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAD.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBADocumentationCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAD.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Help>ABBA - Go to documentation
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAD.description: Opens the ABBA documentation website in a web browser.
messages: Opens https://abba-documentation.readthedocs.io in a web browser.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAF.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAForumHelpCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAF.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Help>ABBA - Ask for help in the forum
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAF.description: Opens a new post draft on the image.sc forum in a web browser, pre-filled with the versions of ABBA and its dependencies.
messages: Opens a web browser. Nothing is posted automatically: the post stays a draft until it is submitted on the forum.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAG.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAGenerateMethodsPrompt
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAG.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Cite>ABBA - Get Prompt for Methods Writing
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAG.description: Generates a prompt describing how the selected slices were registered (atlas, slicing angles, positions, registration steps), to paste in a large language model to draft the methods section of a publication.
messages: Waits for all tasks to be done. Only the selected slices are described. The prompt is returned as an output.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

output.name: llm_prompt_for_methods
output.label: Prompt for the methods section
output.description: Text to copy into a large language model. Review the generated methods carefully.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAS.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBASetBDVPreferencesCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAS.description: Not functional: meant to edit the keyboard and mouse bindings of the ABBA viewer.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAS.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAStartCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAS.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>ABBA - Align Big Brains and Atlases (no GUI)
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAS.description: Starts an ABBA session without graphical user interface (for scripting), with an atlas sliced along the chosen orientation. Outputs the aligner object used by the other ABBA commands.
messages: Select the atlas slicing orientation: click a preset or set the anatomical direction of each axis.

input.name: ba
input.label: Atlas
input.description: Atlas to register the slices to, as output by an atlas opening command.

input.name: x_axis
input.label: X axis (sections, left to right)
input.description: Anatomical direction of the horizontal axis of the displayed sections, from left to right on screen. Coronal: RL, sagittal: AP, horizontal: LR.

input.name: y_axis
input.label: Y axis (sections, top to bottom)
input.description: Anatomical direction of the vertical axis of the displayed sections, from top to bottom on screen. Coronal: SI, sagittal: SI, horizontal: AP.

input.name: z_axis
input.label: Z axis (slicing axis)
input.description: Anatomical direction of the slicing axis, along which the sections are positioned, in increasing position. Coronal: AP, sagittal: LR, horizontal: SI. The three axes must be different.

output.name: mp
output.label: ABBA session
output.description: The ABBA aligner (MultiSlicePositioner) holding the atlas and the slices.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAS.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAStartLogCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAS.description: Opens a debug window which logs the slice events of an ABBA session (creation, deletion, actions).
messages: Opens a window which logs the events of the session from now on.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAS.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAStateLoadCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAS.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>File>ABBA - Load State
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAS.description: Loads a saved ABBA state (.abba file): slices, their positions and registrations, and the atlas slicing angles. The slices are added to the current session. The image files must still be at the location where they were when the state was saved.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: state_file
input.label: State file (.abba)
input.description: ABBA state file to load. It must have been saved with the same atlas.

output.name: success
output.label: Success
output.description: True if the state was loaded.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAS.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAStateSaveCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAS.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>File>ABBA - Save State
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAS.description: Saves the current ABBA session (slices, positions, registrations, atlas slicing angles) in a .abba file. Images are not copied: the file references the original image files. Existing files are not overwritten.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: state_file
input.label: State file (.abba)
input.description: File to create. The '.abba' extension is added if there is none. The file must not exist already.

output.name: success
output.label: Success
output.description: True if the state was saved.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAU.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAUserFeedbackCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAU.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Help>ABBA - Give your feedback
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ABBAU.description: Opens the ABBA user feedback form in a web browser.
messages: Opens the ABBA feedback form in a web browser.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.AutoD.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.AutoDisplayRangeCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.AutoD.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Edit>ABBA - Auto Display Range
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.AutoD.description: Sets the display range of channels of the selected slices from percentiles of their pixel values, measured on a downsampled resolution level. Besides the display, it changes the images sent to DeepSlice, which works best without saturation: run it before DeepSlice.

input.name: high_percentile
input.label: High percentile
input.description: Percentile of the pixel values displayed at full brightness: 99.9 saturates 0.1% of the pixels.

input.name: low_percentile
input.label: Low percentile
input.description: Percentile of the pixel values displayed as black.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: same_range_for_all_slices
input.label: Same range for all slices
input.description: One range per channel, measured on all the selected slices together, so that slices look alike; otherwise one range per slice and channel.

input.name: slice_channels_csv
input.label: Channels
input.description: 0-based indices of the channels to adjust, comma separated (e.g. '0,2'), or '*' for all channels. Channels missing in a slice, and RGB channels, are skipped.

output.name: display_ranges
output.label: Display ranges
output.description: The ranges set: per channel, or per slice and channel.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.DeepS.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.DeepSliceDocumentationCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.DeepS.description: Opens the DeepSlice guide website in a web browser.
messages: Opens https://www.deepslice.com.au/guide in a web browser.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Delet.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.DeleteSlicesCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Delet.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Edit>ABBA - Delete Slices
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Delet.description: Removes slices from the session, as the delete action of the ABBA window does. No file is touched, and undo restores them. Slide scanner files often hold images that are not sections (label, overview, macro): check their names in the state before deleting.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: slices_csv
input.label: Slices
input.description: 0-based indices of the slices along the slicing axis, comma separated (e.g. '0,3'), '*' for all slices, or empty for the selected slices. Indices follow the slice order and change when a slice moves.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Distr.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.DistributeSlicesCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Distr.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Edit>ABBA - Distribute Slices
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Distr.description: Spaces the selected slices evenly along the slicing axis, as 'Distribute Slices [D]' does in the ABBA window. The first and last selected slices and the key slices (ABBA - Set Key Slices) do not move; the slices between two of them are spaced evenly. Needs at least 3 selected slices. One undo step.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ExportAtlasToImageJCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Export>ABBA - Export Atlas to ImageJ
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.description: Exports the atlas section at the position of each selected slice as an ImageJ image, one plane per slice, within the current region of interest. Same geometry as 'Export Registered Slices to ImageJ' with the same pixel size, so both images can be overlaid.

input.name: atlas_channels_csv
input.label: Atlas channels
input.description: 0-based indices of the atlas channels to export, comma separated (e.g. '0,1'), or '*' for all channels. Depending on the atlas, channels include anatomical images, region borders, atlas coordinates, a left/right indicator and region labels.

input.name: image_name
input.label: Image name
input.description: Title of the exported ImageJ image.

input.name: interpolate
input.label: Interpolate
input.description: If checked, pixels are linearly interpolated when resampled; otherwise the nearest pixel is used (keep it unchecked for label channels).

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: pixel_size_um
input.label: Pixel size (micrometers)
input.description: Pixel size of the exported image.

output.name: image
output.label: Image
output.description: Exported atlas image: one channel per atlas channel, one plane per selected slice.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ExportDeformationFieldToImageJCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Export>ABBA - Export Atlas Coordinates of Original Slices to ImageJ
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.description: For each selected slice, exports a 3-channel (x, y, z) 32-bit ImageJ image with the same pixels as the original unregistered slice image: each pixel holds its atlas coordinates, in mm. Waits for the registrations of the slices to be done.

input.name: downsampling
input.label: Additional downsampling factor
input.description: Integer factor to further downsample the exported image, on top of the resolution level. 1 = no downsampling.

input.name: max_number_of_iterations
input.label: Max iterations for transform inversion
input.description: Maximum number of iterations used to numerically invert non-linear (spline) registrations. Increase it if the inversion does not converge. Default 200.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: resolution_level
input.label: Resolution level
input.description: Resolution level of the original image the exported image matches: 0 = full resolution, 1 = first downscaled level, etc. Must exist in the slice files.

output.name: images
output.label: Images
output.description: One coordinates image per selected slice.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ExportRegistrationToQuPathCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Export>ABBA - Export Registrations To QuPath Project
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.description: For each selected slice imported from a QuPath project, saves its atlas regions and its registration (ABBA-RoiSet and ABBA-Transform files) in the QuPath project folder of the image. They are then imported in QuPath with the ABBA extension. Slices not imported from a QuPath project are not exported: slices opened from files can be exported with 'ABBA - Export Slices To New QuPath Project'.

input.name: erase_previous_file
input.label: Overwrite previous export
input.description: If checked, a previous ABBA export of the same image is replaced; otherwise an error is reported for this image.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ExportResampledSlicesToBDVSourceCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Export>ABBA - Export Resampled Slices as BDV Source ( experimental )
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.description: Experimental: fuses the registered selected slices into a 3D volume in atlas coordinates, resampled at the given voxel size and within the current region of interest, as multiresolution BigDataViewer sources (one per channel), computed lazily and cached.

input.name: block_size_x
input.label: Cache block size X (pixels)
input.description: Size along X of the blocks computed and cached at once.

input.name: block_size_y
input.label: Cache block size Y (pixels)
input.description: Size along Y of the blocks computed and cached at once.

input.name: block_size_z
input.label: Cache block size Z (pixels)
input.description: Size along Z of the blocks computed and cached at once.

input.name: downsample_x
input.label: Downsampling between resolution levels X
input.description: Factor along X between two consecutive resolution levels of the output.

input.name: downsample_y
input.label: Downsampling between resolution levels Y
input.description: Factor along Y between two consecutive resolution levels of the output.

input.name: downsample_z
input.label: Downsampling between resolution levels Z
input.description: Factor along Z between two consecutive resolution levels of the output.

input.name: image_name
input.label: Source name
input.description: Base name of the exported sources, '_ch<index>' is appended for each channel.

input.name: interpolate
input.label: Interpolate
input.description: If checked, pixels are linearly interpolated when resampled; otherwise the nearest pixel is used.

input.name: margin_z_um
input.label: Z margin (micrometers)
input.description: Extra space added before the first and after the last selected slice along the slicing axis.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: n_threads
input.label: Number of threads
input.description: Number of threads used to compute the blocks.

input.name: resolution_levels
input.label: Number of resolution levels
input.description: Number of resolution levels of the output sources, at least 1.

input.name: slice_channels_csv
input.label: Slice channels
input.description: 0-based indices of the slice channels to export, comma separated (e.g. '0,2'), or '*' for all channels.

input.name: voxel_size_x_um
input.label: Voxel size X (micrometers)
input.description: Size of the output voxels along the X axis of the sections.

input.name: voxel_size_y_um
input.label: Voxel size Y (micrometers)
input.description: Size of the output voxels along the Y axis of the sections.

input.name: voxel_size_z_um
input.label: Voxel size Z (micrometers)
input.description: Size of the output voxels along the slicing axis.

output.name: fusedImages
output.label: Fused sources
output.description: One fused 3D source per exported channel.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ExportSlicesOriginalDataToImageJCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Export>ABBA - Export Original Slices to ImageJ
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.description: Opens in ImageJ the original, unregistered image of each selected slice, at the chosen resolution level. Fails for images larger than 2 billion pixels (use a lower resolution level). Useful together with the regions exported to the ROI Manager.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: resolution_level
input.label: Resolution level
input.description: 0 = full resolution, 1 = first downscaled level, etc. Must exist in all selected slices.

input.name: slice_channels_csv
input.label: Slice channels
input.description: 0-based indices of the slice channels to export, comma separated (e.g. '0,2'), or '*' for all channels.

input.name: verbose
input.label: Verbose
input.description: If checked, logs the progress of the image loading.

output.name: images
output.label: Images
output.description: One ImageJ image per selected slice.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ExportSlicesToBDVCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Export>ABBA - Export Registered Slices to BDV
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.description: Shows the registered selected slices, placed in atlas coordinates, in a new BigDataViewer window. The sources are also added to the BigDataViewer-Playground source tree. Waits for all ABBA tasks to be done.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: tag
input.label: Tag
input.description: Text stored as the 'ABBA' metadata of each exported source, to identify them later in scripts.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ExportSlicesToBDVJsonDatasetCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Export>ABBA - Export Registered Slices to BDV Json Dataset (Experimental)
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.description: Very experimental: saves the registered selected slices, placed in atlas coordinates, as a BigDataViewer-Playground json file which references the original images. Waits for all ABBA tasks to be done.

input.name: file
input.label: Output file (.json)
input.description: Json file to create.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: tag
input.label: Tag
input.description: Text stored as the 'ABBA' metadata of each exported source, to identify them later in scripts.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ExportSlicesToNewQuPathProjectCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Export>ABBA - Export Slices To New QuPath Project
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.description: Creates a QuPath project (QuPath 0.7) containing the images of the selected slices, with their atlas regions and their registration (ABBA-RoiSet and ABBA-Transform files), which are imported in QuPath with the ABBA extension. Only slices opened from a single series of a 2D file with Bio-Formats can be exported, one slice per image; use 'ABBA - Export Registrations To QuPath Project' for slices imported from a QuPath project.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: project_folder
input.label: QuPath project folder
input.description: Folder of the new QuPath project. It must be empty or not exist yet.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ExportSlicesToQuickNIIDatasetCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Export>ABBA - Export registered slices as QuickNII dataset
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.description: Exports the selected slices as a QuickNII dataset: registered (deformed) slice images resampled within the current region of interest, and a series JSON file with the position of each image in the atlas. The exported images already include all registrations. The folder is created if needed.
messages: WARNING: The QuickNII export will apply all registrations and resample the images. Only JPG seems to be supported.

input.name: convert_to_8_bits
input.label: Convert to 8-bit
input.description: If checked, images are converted to 8-bit before being saved.

input.name: convert_to_jpg
input.label: Save as JPEG
input.description: If checked, images are saved as JPEG, the format QuickNII reads; a single channel is recommended. Otherwise they are saved as TIFF.

input.name: dataset_folder
input.label: Output folder
input.description: Folder where the images ('<prefix>_s000.jpg'...) and the '<prefix>.json' series file are written.

input.name: image_name
input.label: File name prefix
input.description: Prefix of the exported image files and name of the JSON series file.

input.name: interpolate
input.label: Interpolate
input.description: If checked, pixels are linearly interpolated when resampled; otherwise the nearest pixel is used.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: pixel_size_um
input.label: Pixel size (micrometers)
input.description: Pixel size at which the registered slices are resampled.

input.name: slice_channels_csv
input.label: Slice channels
input.description: 0-based indices of the slice channels to export, comma separated (e.g. '0,2'), or '*' for all channels.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ExportStdZipStateCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Export>ABBA - Export Standardized ABBA Project (Zip)
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Expor.description: Creates a standardized, shareable zip of the current ABBA session: all slices downscaled to a given pixel size, their registrations, their deformation fields and metadata (atlas, slicing orientation, experiment information). The zip can be opened with 'Import Standardized ABBA Project (Zip)'. The session itself is not modified.
messages: Exports all slices of the session, downscaled, with their registrations. Wait for the end of the export before modifying the session.

input.name: downscale_deformation_field
input.label: Deformation field downscaling factor
input.description: The deformation field (atlas coordinates of each pixel) is computed every N pixels of the exported slices.

input.name: experiment_information
input.label: Experiment information
input.description: Free text describing the experiment (animal, staining, sectioning...), stored in the metadata of the zip.

input.name: identifier
input.label: Export identifier
input.description: Short name of the export, used in the zip file name: abba_export_<identifier>.zip.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session to export.

input.name: output_folder
input.label: Output folder
input.description: Folder where the zip is written. A zip with the same name must not exist.

input.name: pixel_size_um
input.label: Pixel size of the exported slices (micrometers)
input.description: The original slice images are downscaled to this pixel size to keep the zip small.

input.name: slice_channels_csv

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.GetSt.description: Returns the state of the session as JSON, once the queued work is done or after 'timeout_s' seconds. Compact by default: 'pending_actions', the number of queued actions not done yet - above 0, positions and registrations are not final: call 'ABBA - Wait' -, the last 'failures' of the session (10 at most, one line each), the atlas, its channels in index order, the slicing angles, the region of interest, and per slice its index, name, position 'z_mm' (as displayed), 'thickness_mm', selection, key slice flag, channel names, registrations and 'pending' actions if any. With 'full': the content of a state file instead, plus per slice its index, name, channels, selection and position in both conventions ('z_mm' as displayed, 'slicing_axis_position' as stored), long transforms elided, and 'pending_actions' and 'failures' as well.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session to read.

input.name: slices_csv
input.label: Slices
input.description: 0-based indices of the slices along the slicing axis, comma separated (e.g. '0,3'), '*' for all slices, or empty for the selected slices. Indices follow the slice order and change when a slice moves.

input.name: timeout_s

output.name: state

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Regis.description: Removes the last registration of each selected slice (it can be undone).

input.name: mp

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Reind.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.ReindexSlicesCommand

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Rotat.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.RotateSlicesCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Rotat.description: Rotates the selected slices around the center of the registration ROI. Z: in-plane rotation, clockwise on screen. X or Y: 180 or -180 degrees only (flip)

input.description: Rotation angle. Around Z, positive is clockwise on screen.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetAt.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetAtlasSlicingAnglesCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetAt.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Edit>ABBA - Set Atlas Slicing Angles
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetAt.description: Sets the angles at which the atlas is sliced, for all slices of the session: the correction for a cutting plane that was not perfectly orthogonal. DeepSlice sets them when 'Adjust atlas slicing angle' is checked. Not undoable: note the current angles first (ABBA - Get State, slicing_angle_x_deg and slicing_angle_y_deg). 'ABBA - Adjust Slicing' is its interactive form.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: x_degrees
input.label: Rotation around X (degrees)
input.description: Rotation of the slicing plane around the horizontal axis of the sections.

input.name: y_degrees
input.label: Rotation around Y (degrees)
input.description: Rotation of the slicing plane around the vertical axis of the sections.

output.name: angles
output.label: Angles
output.description: The angles now in use, in degrees.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetKe.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetKeySlicesCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetKe.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Edit>ABBA - Set Key Slices
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetKe.description: Marks slices as key slices (or unmarks them). Key slices keep their position when ABBA - Distribute Slices spaces the others evenly: place 2 or 3 of them where you trust the position. One undo step.

input.name: key
input.label: Key slice
input.description: Checked: mark as key slices. Unchecked: remove the mark.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: slices_csv
input.label: Slices
input.description: 0-based indices of the slices along the slicing axis, comma separated (e.g. '0,3'), '*' for all slices, or empty for the selected slices. Indices follow the slice order and change when a slice moves.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetRe.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetRegionOfInterestCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetRe.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Edit>ABBA - Set Region Of Interest
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetRe.description: Sets the rectangular region of interest (ROI) of the session: registrations only consider this region, and exports to images are cropped to it. It applies to all slices. For hemi-sections, restrict it to the hemisphere, and restore the full size afterwards. 'ABBA - Get State' gives the current one (roi_mm).

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: region_mm
input.label: Region (mm)
input.description: 'x,y,width,height' in mm, x and y being the top left corner, in the coordinates of the rulers of 'ABBA - Snapshot' (the full atlas section is centred on 0). Empty for the full atlas section.

output.name: roi_mm
output.label: Region of interest (mm)
output.description: The region now in use: x,y,width,height in mm.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSlicesBackgroundCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Edit>ABBA - Set Slice Background
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.description: For brightfield images with a white background: the area outside of the selected slices images is filled with this value instead of black, which avoids dark edges during registrations and exports. Works for 8-bit, 16-bit and RGB images.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: white_background_value
input.label: Background value
input.description: Pixel value used outside of the images: 255 for 8-bit or RGB images, 65535 for 16-bit images.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSlicesDeselectedCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Edit>ABBA - Deselect Slices
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.description: Removes slices from the current selection, by index. Other slices keep their selection state.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: slices_csv
input.label: Slice indices
input.description: 0-based indices of the slices, in the order along the slicing axis. '*' for all slices, comma separated values ('0,3'), inclusive ranges ('2:5'), ranges with a step ('0:2:10'). Negative indices count from the end: -1 is the last slice.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSlicesDisplayRangeCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Edit>ABBA - Set Slices Min Max Display Range
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.description: Sets the display range (min and max displayed values) of channels of the selected slices. Besides the display, it changes the images sent to DeepSlice: avoid saturated images.

input.name: display_max
input.label: Display max
input.description: Pixel value displayed at full brightness; higher values are saturated.

input.name: display_min
input.label: Display min
input.description: Pixel value displayed as black.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: slice_channels_csv
input.label: Channels
input.description: 0-based indices of the channels to adjust, comma separated (e.g. '0,2'), or '*' for all channels. Channels missing in a slice are skipped.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSlicesSelectedCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Edit>ABBA - Select Slices
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.description: Adds slices to the current selection, by index. Already selected slices stay selected. Most commands act on the selected slices.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: slices_csv
input.label: Slice indices
input.description: 0-based indices of the slices, in the order along the slicing axis. '*' for all slices, comma separated values ('0,3'), inclusive ranges ('2:5'), ranges with a step ('0:2:10'). Negative indices count from the end: -1 is the last slice.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSlicesThicknessCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Edit>ABBA - Set Slices Thickness
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.description: Sets the thickness of the selected slices along the slicing axis. It affects the 3D display (reconstructed brain) and the 3D resampled export, not the registrations.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: thickness_um
input.label: Slice thickness (micrometers)
input.description: Thickness of each selected slice, centered on its position.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSlicesThicknessMatchNeighborsCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Edit>ABBA - Set Slices Thickness (fill gaps)
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SetSl.description: Sets the thickness of each selected slice so that it extends halfway to its neighbors, leaving no gap between slices. It affects the 3D display (reconstructed brain) and the 3D resampled export, not the registrations.
messages: Needs at least two slices. The neighbors of a slice are the slices before and after it along the slicing axis, selected or not.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Snaps.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.SnapshotCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.Snaps.description: Renders slices with the atlas region borders at their current registration, or an earlier one, independently of the window: a header describes each slice and rulers give coordinates in mm. Several slices are tiled. Region labels are the atlas at the slice position, not an observation: after an import that position is a placeholder (the header says 'reg=0'). Hide borders and labels to look at the tissue alone.

input.name: atlas_channel
input.label: Atlas channel
input.description: Index of an atlas channel blended with the slice, -1 for none ('atlas_channels' in 'ABBA - Get State' lists them in index order).

input.name: columns
input.label: Columns
input.description: Tiles per row when several slices are rendered, 0 for automatic.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session to render.

input.name: pixel_size_mm
input.label: Pixel size (mm)
input.description: Pixel size of the rendered image; smaller is sharper and slower.

input.name: region_mm
input.label: Region (mm)
input.description: Rendered region 'x,y,width,height' in mm, x and y being its top left corner as read on the rulers (e.g. '-1,0.5,2,2' for a 2 mm square). Empty for the whole region of interest. With a small region, lower the pixel size to see details.

input.name: registration_step_back
input.label: Registration step back
input.description: Renders the slices as they were this many registrations ago, 0 for their current registration (as 'View Previous' in the window). The header then says 'reg=shown/total', e.g. 'reg=2/4'; a slice with fewer registrations is rendered unregistered. Only the registrations are undone: the slice keeps its current position along the slicing axis.

input.name: slice_channels_csv
input.label: Slice channels
input.description: 0-based indices of the slice channels to render, comma separated (e.g. '0' for the first channel alone), or '*' for all channels. Each channel is rendered with its current display settings.

input.name: slices_csv
input.label: Slices
input.description: 0-based indices of the slices along the slicing axis, comma separated (e.g. '0,3'), '*' for all slices, or empty for the selected slices. Indices follow the slice order and change when a slice moves.

output.name: regions
output.label: Labelled regions
output.description: With region labels: each labelled region as 'acronym: full name', one per line, from the atlas ontology.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.UndoC.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.UndoCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.UndoC.menuPath: Plugins>BIOP>Atlas>Multi Image To Atlas>Edit>ABBA - Undo or Redo
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.UndoC.description: Undoes (or redoes) the last user actions of a session, as Ctrl+Z (Ctrl+Shift+Z) does in the ABBA window. One step undoes a whole command, a registration of several slices included. The atlas slicing angles are not undone.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session the command acts on.

input.name: steps
input.label: Steps
input.description: Number of actions to undo; negative to redo.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.WaitC.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.WaitCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.aligner.command.WaitC.description: Waits until the actions queued on the slices are done, at most 'timeout_s' seconds, then tells how many are still pending and what failed since the previous 'ABBA - Wait'. Registration and DeepSlice commands return as soon as their actions are queued, and their failures come later: follow them with this command, and call it again while 'pending_actions' is above 0.

input.name: mp
input.label: ABBA session
input.description: The ABBA session to wait for.

input.name: timeout_s
input.label: Timeout (s)
input.description: Longest wait, in seconds. Clients usually give up on a call after about 60 s: keep it under 45, and call again while actions are pending.

output.name: failures
output.label: Failures
output.description: The failures recorded since the previous 'ABBA - Wait' on this session, one per line ('#index hh:mm:ss action on slices: reason'), or empty.

output.name: pending_actions
output.label: Pending actions
output.description: Number of actions still queued or running, 0 once all are done.

output.name: summary
output.label: Summary
output.description: One line, for instance 'done: no pending action, no new failure' or '3 actions pending after 30 s; 1 new failure'.

ch.epfl.biop.atlas.scijava.BrainGlobeAtl.name: ch.epfl.biop.atlas.scijava.BrainGlobeAtlasListCommand
ch.epfl.biop.atlas.scijava.BrainGlobeAtl.description: Lists every atlas published by BrainGlobe (the latest version of each), and the ones already downloaded on this computer. Any of them opens with 'Open Atlas', with its name and version as the choice (e.g. allen_mouse_25um@3.0): one not downloaded yet is downloaded first (minutes, up to a few GB). The first listing of a Fiji session needs BrainGlobe's Python environment, which takes minutes to build the first time on a computer. Afterwards, 'Open Atlas' offers the whole list too.
